value.title: Travels
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei takes a special train to the mysterious Cassel College, and discovers the school's true purpose.

value.title: Day of Freedom
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei arrives at Cassel on the Day of Freedom, a day when anything is allowed. Within his first few minutes of arriving, he finds himself in the middle of a gunfight...

value.title: Two Dragon Emperors
value.synopsis: When Lu Mingfei fails to react at all to the 3E test, the professors suspect that he is heir to a powerful legacy...

value.title: Dragon Palace
value.synopsis: Two students of Cassel College become trapped in a mysterious dragon palace at the bottom of a dam site lake.

value.title: Spoils of Victory
value.synopsis: Aki and Ye Sheng fight to escape from the underwater palace before their air runs out, but something terrible waits for them down below...

value.title: Intruders
value.synopsis: As Lu Mingfei is invited to a fancy party, a group of intruders assaults the campus.

value.title: Unleashing Yanling
value.synopsis: With the Night Watchman's protective Yanling disabled, the students are free to unleash their full powers.

value.title: The Dragon Emperor of Bronze and Flames
value.synopsis: As Lu Mingfei speaks with Nono atop a mountain, the battle for the urn comes to a conclusion.

value.title: Vow to Reunite
value.synopsis: A powerful dragon stalks the campus as Lu Mingfei reunites with an old friend.

value.title: Brotherly Memories
value.synopsis: Lao Tang regains his memories as the principal's plans for the dragons are revealed.

value.title: Dangerous Mission
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei is selected to go on a deadly underwater mission beneath a dam.

value.title: Dragon's Lair
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei infiltrates the heart of the Dragon Emperor's lair and is shocked by what he sees.

value.title: Escape from the Labyrinth
value.synopsis: Nono and Lu Mingfei try to escape from the Dragon Emperor's palace after planting a devastating bomb, but the dragons won't let them escape easily...

value.title: Our Full Strength
value.synopsis: Cassel College's top leaders, Chu Zihang and Caesar, bring their full power to bear against Norton.

value.title: Deal with the Devil
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei makes a deal with potentially devastating consequences to get the power he needs to save Nono.

value.title: The End of Battle
value.synopsis: Lu Mingfei's duel against Norton comes to an end, but at what cost?
